dialog.title: Download {{title}}
dialog.description: Send this release to a download client. The destination decides where it lands.

optionsFailed: Could not load the download clients.
optionsRefreshFailed: Could not load the download clients again, showing the last loaded ones.
noClients: No download client can take this release yet. The owner sets them up under Integrations and Destinations.

summary.title: Summary
summary.kept: Kept: nothing is replaced or removed, and a release that would write over a different file isn't sent.
summary.conditions: Conditions: the old copy moves into the quarantine only after the new one is downloaded, checked and shown in Jellyfin as the same work; a copy held by a torrent waits until you remove that torrent in {{client}}. Once the download is done, the app checks that the new file is complete, readable and identified by Jellyfin as the old copy's work. The old copy stays in the quarantine until you restore it or delete it permanently on the job's page.

replace.notOwner: Only the installation owner can replace a copy.
replace.optionsRefreshFailed: Could not check your copies again, showing the last answer.
replace.noneAvailable: None of your copies can be replaced: see why below.
replace.switchedOffLinked: Replacement is switched off. Switch it on, and tick the folders it may touch, on the <page>Media folders</page> page.

unavailable.SwitchedOff: Replacement is switched off. Switch it on, and tick the folders it may touch, on the Media folders page.
unavailable.Magnet: This release is a magnet link: the app can't check its files before sending.
unavailable.DestinationNotUsable: The destination's folder isn't confirmed inside a library the app knows.
unavailable.NoMatchedWork: This release matches no film or held episodes of yours.

replace.notChecked: The app can't check this destination's folder for files already there, and a replacement is sent only after that check. Pick another destination, or Keep both.

workUnavailable.TitleOnly: Matched by title alone, which never allows a replacement.
workUnavailable.ConflictingIds: Its ids conflict ({{schemes}}), so it can't be replaced.
workUnavailable.NoClaimedEpisodes: You hold none of the episodes this release claims.
workUnavailable.NoClaimedSeason: This release's title names no season, so the app can't tell which episodes it would replace.

replace.confirmHint: Matched by title and year only. Your tick lets the app schedule this; nothing moves unless Jellyfin later gives the new file this work's id.

copyUnavailable.NoAppPath: The app can't reach this file: it has no path in the app, or lies outside the Media folders.
copyUnavailable.FolderNotTicked: Its folder isn't ticked for replacement on the Media folders page.
copyUnavailable.ChangedSinceInspection: Changed since the app inspected it.
copyUnavailable.Missing: The file isn't there any more.
copyUnavailable.Unreadable: The app can't read this file now.
copyUnavailable.OutsideTheClaim: The library places this version outside the episodes this release claims.
copyUnavailable.AlreadyScheduled: A replacement scheduled earlier already holds this copy.
copyUnavailable.SharedWithUnavailableWork: This file is also a copy of another work this release matched, which can't be replaced.
copyUnavailable.HeldByRemoval: A removal under Removed copies on the Duplicates page holds this copy.

replace.heldBy_one: Held by the torrent “{{torrent}}” in “{{client}}”: before this copy can move you'll remove that torrent there without its files — which also stops seeding its other files.
replace.heldBy_other: Held by the torrent “{{torrent}}” in “{{client}}” ({{value}} of these copies): before these copies can move you'll remove that torrent there without its files — which also stops seeding its other files.
replace.otherNames: This file has another name, so moving it frees no space.
replace.clientNotRead: Couldn't check whether a torrent in “{{client}}” holds these copies: {{error}}
replace.clientNotReadNoReason: Couldn't check whether a torrent in “{{client}}” holds these copies.
replace.clientPartial_one: Couldn't check {{value}} torrent in “{{client}}”: its files couldn't be placed in the app's folders.
replace.clientPartial_other: Couldn't check {{value}} torrents in “{{client}}”: their files couldn't be placed in the app's folders.
replace.tickSeason: Tick every copy that can be replaced ({{value}})

overwrite.NotCheckedFolderUnknown: The app can't check whether this release would write over a file already there: the destination's folder has no path in the app, or its download client can't say where it is. A release sent there goes without that check.
overwrite.NotCheckedFolderOutsideMediaFolders: The app can't check whether this release would write over a file already there: the destination's folder isn't under Media folders, which the installation owner sets in the user menu. A release sent there goes without that check.
overwrite.NotCheckedFolderNotSeen: This destination's download client can't see its folder, so nothing will be sent there until the owner fixes the destination under Destinations in the user menu.

folderUnknown.ClientNotAsked: The app couldn't ask “{{client}}” where this destination saves, so a release sent there goes without the check for files it would write over.
folderUnknown.CategoryMissing: “{{client}}” no longer has this destination's category, so a release sent there goes without the check for files it would write over. The owner picks another category under Destinations in the user menu.
folderUnknown.NoPathMapping: No path mapping of “{{client}}” brings this destination's folder into the app, so a release sent there goes without the check for files it would write over. The owner adds one under Integrations, “{{client}}”, Path mappings.

overwrite.askOwner: Ask the owner to check “{{client}}” under Integrations.

pickFirst: Pick a download client and a destination first.

outcome.Created: This release is already being sent to {{client}}. Its outcome isn't known yet.
outcome.Submitted: {{client}} took the release and lists it among its downloads.
outcome.SubmittedUnlisted: {{client}} took the release, but hasn't listed it among its downloads yet.
outcome.Paused: {{client}} took the release, but its download is paused there.
outcome.NeedsLinking: {{client}} took the release, but the app can't tell which of its downloads it is, so it has to be linked by hand.
outcome.Cancelled: {{client}} took the release, but its job has been cancelled since, so the app doesn't follow it.
